snippet.title: Vacuous Sugar Quest trailer
snippet.description:
Vacuous Sugar Quest is a 2D platformer featuring climbing and gliding mechanics.

Play as Vac, an adventurer trying to climb Sugar Mountain to prove her sugar gliding abilities!

Available for free on itch.io: https://walfie.itch.io/vacuous-sugar-quest
